name: aegilops_tauschii_aet_v4
key_challenge: Wheat D-genome donor — wheat-like repeat landscape without hexaploidy, diploid tractable alternative to T8a/T8b

reference.notes: VERIFY: Aet v5.0 and v6.0 exist at NCBI. Confirm you want v4.0 (GCA_002575655.1) or update to the latest version deliberately. The D-subgenome is the closest diploid relative of the wheat D subgenome.

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCA_002575655.1 --include genome --filename ncbi_dataset.zip && unzip -o ncbi_dataset.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCA_002575655.1/*.fna > reference.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset ncbi_dataset.zip

simulation.command: art_illumina -ss HS25 -i ../reference/reference.fasta -p -l 150 -f 10 -rs {rng_seed} -o reads && gzip reads1.fq reads2.fq && mv reads1.fq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads2.fq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

truth.simulated: art_illumina read name encodes true origin; parse with custom comparator or paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Diploid tractable alternative to T8a/T8b. Use when the hexaploid scale of T8a/T8b is not required but wheat-like repeat content is. 4.3 Gb diploid (DD, 2n=2x=14).

curation.notes: VERIFY assembly version before download — Aet v5.0 and v6.0 are available and may be preferable.
